headline: US Stocks Rise With Nasdaq Leading on Nvidia AI Partnerships
summary: US equity markets advanced led by the Nasdaq after Nvidia announced artificial intelligence partnerships, alongside earnings strength in Meta and Tesla.
why: Major US equity indexes reflect broad investor appetite for risk and the momentum of heavyweight technology companies.

impacts.name: Nasdaq Composite
impacts.why: Gains in major tech names and new AI deals lifted the tech-heavy benchmark index.

why_moved: US equities rose as the Nasdaq outperformed, driven by Nvidia's new AI partnerships announced at its keynote and post-earnings gains in Meta and Tesla.
